action: Set application runAsUser and runAsGroup to 10001 in the release manifest. Rebuild, scan, verify signed artifacts, deploy to the vendor test namespace and measure the application process identity.
risk: The original UID/GID values did not meet the selected vendor workload hardening criterion. This is a scoped engineering correction, not an agency risk determination or a mandatory POA&M for a low-severity scan result.
resources: Application engineering, the existing CI runners and the vendor-owned test namespace. No shared cluster baseline changes.
protection: Existing non-root enforcement, read-only root filesystem, dropped capabilities, seccomp and namespace network policy retained. Network and mTLS enforcement are outside this retest.

milestones.description: Rescan and verify signed release artifacts
Deploy vendor test and capture process identity and health

tests.description: Configuration rescan no longer reports KSV-0020 or KSV-0021
tests.result: KSV-0020/0021 absent. Configuration findings: 3 → 1. KSV-0125 remains.

tests.description: Actual application process UID and GID match the corrected manifest
tests.result: 2 application processes measured UID 10001 / GID 10001. Expected identities match.

tests.result: 2/2 pods ready on the corrected image. /healthz HTTP 200.
